summary: Edesa Biotech filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose favorable exploratory data for paridiprubart in acute kidney injury patients from its Phase 2/3 ARDS studies. The filing reports a 32% relative mortality reduction and 23% MAKE30 improvement versus placebo, with no mention of any merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or special situation. The disclosure is purely clinical trial results, not a corporate event. No deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic reviews are discussed. As it is not a special-situation filing, the appropriate classification is None.
